requested_window_semantics: Record requested_start/requested_end separately from actual returned bounds.
actual_available_window: Use non-empty adjusted=True response bounds; compare with raw observed bounds and listing/delisting authority when available.
post_delisting: EXPECTED_NO_HISTORY after authority boundary; do not fill.
missing_trading_dates: No generic fill; preserve provider trading-date set.
coverage_gate: Per-ticker pair is valid only when schema/provenance/hash/identity pass and returned bounds are recorded; no universal 4095-row requirement.
